parent="c587b20f5f28187c1fed04323e6f6b118982282c"

old=subprocess.check_output(["git","show",parent+":"+str(path)])
new=path.read_bytes()
before=ast.parse(old)
after=ast.parse(new)
base=pathlib.Path(".agent/tasks/production-readiness-20260917/evidence")
red=json.loads((base/"legacy-leaf-causal-baseline-20260921.json").read_text())
final=json.loads((base/"parser-privacy-final-20260921.json").read_text())
assert red["exit_code"]==1 and "FAILED (failures=3)" in red["stderr"] and "ERROR:" not in red["stderr"]
assert final["exit_code"]==0 and "86 passed, 4 subtests passed" in final["stdout"]
for capture in [red,final]:
    assert not any(capture[k] for k in ("timed_out","stdout_truncated","stderr_truncated"))
redmeta=json.loads(red["stdout"])
meta=json.loads(final["stdout"].splitlines()[0])
assert redmeta["parent_source_sha256"]==hashlib.sha256(old).hexdigest()
assert redmeta["test_sha256"]==meta["source_sha256"]["tests/test_legacy_parser_leaf_diagnostics.py"]
for p,h in meta["source_sha256"].items(): assert hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==h,p
test=ast.parse(pathlib.Path("tests/test_legacy_parser_leaf_diagnostics.py").read_text())
declared=ast.literal_eval(next(n.value for n in test.body if isinstance(n,ast.Assign) and any(isinstance(t,ast.Name) and t.id=="CHANGED_SINKS" for t in n.targets)))
def prints(function):
    return [n for n in ast.walk(function) if isinstance(n,ast.Expr) and isinstance(n.value,ast.Call) and isinstance(n.value.func,ast.Name) and n.value.func.id=="print"]
changed=[]
for original in before.body:
    if not isinstance(original,ast.FunctionDef): continue
    current=next(n for n in after.body if isinstance(n,ast.FunctionDef) and n.name==original.name)
    oldprints,newprints=prints(original),prints(current)
    assert len(oldprints)==len(newprints),original.name
    for a,b in zip(oldprints,newprints):
        if ast.dump(a)!=ast.dump(b): changed.append((original.name,a,b))
assert len(changed)==len(declared)==39
matched=set()
for name,a,b in changed:
    indices=[i for i,(fn,oldfragment,newfragment) in enumerate(declared) if fn==name and oldfragment in ast.unparse(a) and newfragment in ast.unparse(b)]
    assert len(indices)==1,(name,indices)
    matched.add(indices[0])
assert len(matched)==39
class Normalize(ast.NodeTransformer):
    def visit_Expr(self,node):
        if isinstance(node.value,ast.Call) and isinstance(node.value.func,ast.Name) and node.value.func.id=="print": return ast.Pass()
        return self.generic_visit(node)
    def visit_ExceptHandler(self,node):
        node.name=None
        return self.generic_visit(node)
assert ast.dump(Normalize().visit(before))==ast.dump(Normalize().visit(after))
